title: Quantum simulation in the Heisenberg picture via vectorization
summary: We present a general framework for simulating quantum systems in the Heisenberg picture on quantum hardware. Based on the vectorization map, our framework fully exploits the mapping between operators and quantum states, allowing any task defined on Heisenberg operators to be mapped to standard Schrödinger-picture tasks that are naturally accessible via quantum computers and simulators.
